cat > programs/task-5754908d.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            if v:
                colors[v] = colors.get(v, 0) + 1
    main = max(colors, key=colors.get)
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == main]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    others = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] != main]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Extend each row of the rectangle outward unless a marker lies in that ray.
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        if not any(rr == r and cc < c0 for rr, cc in others):
            for c in range(c0):
                if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = main
        if not any(rr == r and cc > c1 for rr, cc in others):
            for c in range(c1 + 1, w):
                if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = main
    # Extend each column of the rectangle upward/downward unless blocked by a marker.
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if not any(cc == c and rr < r0 for rr, cc in others):
            for r in range(r0):
                if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = main
        if not any(cc == c and rr > r1 for rr, cc in others):
            for r in range(r1 + 1, h):
                if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = main
    return out
PY
